settings.scope: Independent dense one-coordinate central differences versus simultaneous three-cell coloring at identical physical steps. Explicit cumulative-ledger zero columns, and entropy-production derivative assembled from affected faces. No change to physical RHS, coefficients or integration budgets. A numerical Jacobian approximation, not an admitted analytic chemical-potential tangent.

geometry.classification: Virtual uniform1D100cm3 chain, sealed left end and externally contacted right terminal control volume. Immobile pure solids and rigid cells; no measured brick shape or pores.

transport.classification: Explicit virtual continuum coefficients. Face conductance/mobility scales as area over center distance; neither inferred nor measured brick transport.

settings.initial_mapping: Divide the qualified capsule elemental inventories and total volume equally; same uniform initial temperature and full external conductance/mobilities/radiative port. One cell must match the already qualified capsule. Internal faces scale conductance and mobility as area/center distance.
settings.external_contact_definition: Gas/thermal film and ideal black radiative port couple directly to the terminal control-volume temperature and potentials. No extra surface storage, half-cell resistance or hidden massless-surface solve. This is the declared discrete approximation; spatial convergence must be shown separately before a continuum claim.

numerics.inventory_absolute_tolerance_basis: Whole-capsule original absolute tolerance divided by actual cell count; ledger and temperature tolerances unchanged.

settings.scope: Develop and qualify one/two cells before finer grids. Source-defined positive inventory equilibrium and caloric-only tangent; do not use unqualified analytic gas-potential inventory Jacobians. No real material, finite kinetics, deformation or full brick cycle qualification.

cell_settings.scope: Next phase, integration permitted only after constant separate-reservoir full qualification: positive-inventory capsule with independently prescribed gas and radiation thermal programs, heating/hold/cooling/hold and composition change. Preserve full source/element/U/entropy/time budgets; all transport and schedules are virtual, not kiln calibration.

radiation.area_classification: Declared virtual radiative port of1cm2, not measured brick surface or pore geometry.

source.numerical_representation: Nearest binary64 of80-digit evaluation from exact SI kB,h,c. Physical sigma is exact with irrational expression; stored finite number is an approximation.

radiation.entropy_scope: Combined material plus prescribed thermal reservoir, neglect radiation-field storage; Q/Twall is reservoir entropy loss, not a claim that photon entropy flux equals Q/Twall.

cell_settings.boundary_definition: Continuous affine gas T,P,y and radiation T; BDF restarts at every knot at physical time. Radiation source and gas bath entropy and energies are separate; maintaining the imposed reservoirs is outside the boundary.

internal_face_parameters.classification: Virtual thermodynamic transport closure. Conductance and diagonal gas mobilities are design values, not measured brick permeability, diffusivity, or kinetics.

source_basis.scope: General thermodynamic flux-force formulation only. This source does not supply the selected diagonal coefficients, arithmetic face enthalpy, or real-brick validity.

internal_face_parameters.definition: Positive left-to-right flow: F_i=mu_i,L/T_L-mu_i,R/T_R+hbar_i*(1/T_R-1/T_L); J_i=L_i*F_i; E=G*(T_L-T_R)+sum(hbar_i*J_i); hbar_i=(h_i,L+h_i,R)/2. Total entropy rate is G*(T_L-T_R)^2/(T_L*T_R)+sum(L_i*F_i^2). Equal opposite elemental and energy rates couple rigid cells with immobile solids.
